{{Quote|Liam, the shades.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Liam''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A part of the [[Bear Clan]], he was one of its brightest members.

When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disturbed [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] instruction of the Bear Clan on [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] usage for help on locating the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the venerable [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] told Liam to lower the shades so that the star map could be viewed.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] DVD commentary, the character's name is a reference to [[Liam Neeson]], the actor who played the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']].
